name: Commerce Product Menu UI
description: Adds menu link creation to the Commerce product form.
project_description:
Integrates menu ui with commerce products. Allows to add commerce products into the menu tree directly from the product add / edit page. 

 Back to top 

 Installation and configuration 
 Install and enable the module and enjoy menu integration in commerce product forms. Kept simple! ;)

 Back to top 

 History 
 Based on our requirements to be able to add commerce products to menus directly from the product UI (like core menu_ui for nodes) I created this module. Other Drupal Commerce users also requested this functionality in [#2882936] which will now contain the discussion to include this module into commerce_product as submodule.

Hopefully these kind of solutions will one day be superseeded by a better general core solution in [#2315773]. Please push that issue and help coding there!

 Token support 
 Token support for [commerce_product:menu-link:...] was added in >=1.3.

 You may want to use a fallback in pathauto for commerce products:

 [commerce_product:menu-link:parent:url:path]/[commerce_product:title] to use the menu structure for products.

 Back to top 

 Possible alternative 
 Less lightweight and I haven't tested it yet but maybe: https://www.drupal.org/project/menu_link
